description: Theme role for every hardcoded hex color in fabric/powerbi/*.Report and fabric/twins/*.Report (base themes excluded), including colors inside embedded SVG wallpapers (data:image/svg+xml). Custom business layouts (retail-setup customize) remap each color to its role in the derived brand theme; 'role~0.8' is that role tinted 80% toward white; 'fixed' colors (canvas white, black text, good/warn/bad status, the wallpaper's alpha mask) never change. A contract test fails when a report gains an unmapped color.
